data.title: 菲伦 · 晨雾森林·法杖凝聚与极速魔法
data.description: 【菲伦 · 晨雾森林·法杖凝聚与极速魔法】晨雾弥漫的古老森林深处，菲伦神情沉稳冷静地举起木质法杖，杖尖瞬间凝聚起耀眼而高密度的纯白魔法光弹。她眼神凌厉如刀，衣袍在魔力气流中翻滚——「芙莉莲大人教导过，普通攻击魔法只要速度足够快，就能击溃一切对手。请退后，猎物交给我来处理。」
data.promptProse: Fern plants her boots on the damp forest path and raises a complete wooden staff with both hands spaced along its shaft. A compact white mana sphere forms at the tip above her steady violet eyes. Her black hooded coat reveals the high-collared white dress and half-up purple hair. The full-body view follows trees into morning mist; pale filtered rays and sphere light illuminate her hands, with shaded roots beneath her stance.
data.camera: full-body shot, staff tip and both hands visible
